observations.result: The live page title was Wild Crown — The Broken Pact. The title UI exposed New Game, disabled Continue, Load Game, Settings, and Credits. No uncaught page error was present in the clean observation.

A page DOM click on the Settings action rendered the settings menu with audio/accessibility controls. During that observation the Stick Deadzone control was absent; the UI owner was still editing the screen, so this is not final settings acceptance evidence.

The Load Game local screen rendered an empty save slot, Save Slot +, Import Save, Export Save, Back, and a JSON file input. The malformed-file dispatch was attempted, but live HMR replaced the screen before the input upload could complete; import-error behavior remains unverified.

This prevented stable final missing-assets and lifecycle smoke coverage.
